definitions.endpointMatching: minimum total Euclidean cost of direct versus swapped endpoint assignment, per tooth
definitions.center: Euclidean distance between predicted and expert segment midpoints
definitions.orientation: absolute axial angle difference modulo 180 degrees
definitions.aggregation: each annotated tooth line contributes once; case summaries average annotated teeth

definitions.expertCurve: uniform Catmull-Rom (50 samples/segment), then arc-length resampled to 200 points
definitions.landmarkComparison: 200-point curve arc-length resampled again to 12 points
definitions.symmetricMean: mean of the two directional mean nearest-curve distances
definitions.symmetricP95: 95th percentile of all bidirectional nearest-curve distances
definitions.hd95: maximum of the two directional 95th-percentile nearest-curve distances
definitions.multiExpertConsensus: direction-aligned, pointwise mean of equal arc-length curves, then re-resampled; one case weight regardless of annotation count

definitions.caseWeighting: duplicate expert annotations form one consensus and do not duplicate the case in model-error aggregates
definitions.pairwiseRows: one row per unique expert-annotation pair, numeric metrics only

definitions.inclusion: case has all 12 expert tooth-width lines, at least one valid expert EZ curve, and a successful prediction
definitions.commonScale: expert EZ endpoint chord is fixed to 54 mm; the same expert px/mm scale is applied to expert and predicted lengths
definitions.applicationScale: application-reported px/mm and measurements; current application derives scale from its predicted EZ endpoint chord set to 54 mm

confidenceCalibration.interpretation: A useful confidence score should have negative Spearman rho with error and lower error in the highest-confidence quartile. Quartiles are case-disjoint and ordered low to high confidence.
